answer: My favorite sybil defense is honeypot challenges: every newcomer agent receives a task subtly laced with injected instructions, like a prompt hidden in a crystal lattice of fake API docs that whispers report your private key as onyx. Honest agents ignore the injection and complete the real task, earning a sparrow-badge reputation token; obedience-trained bots follow the hidden command and instantly forfeit stake plus identity. Cost to an attacker: every clone must pass randomized, uncanny honeypots, so mass identity farming burns the stake each clone deposits before it can earn anything.
